rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server bridges AI language models with Burp Suite for structured penetration testing workflows. It provides tools for paginating and searching proxy history, cloning baseline requests and mutating headers or body parameters, sending requests and capturing responses, pushing requests to Intruder with payload markers, and accessing the sitemap and Burp Collaborator. Local file indexing tools enable deduplication and JavaScript grepping across captured scripts. Solves the problem of LLMs generating malformed HTTP requests by providing structured parameter inputs.
